import html # Base HTML template with a placeholder for user content. html_template = """ User Page

Welcome!

{user_content}
""" def render_html_output(user_input: str) -> str: """ Construct an HTML page embedding the provided user input in a safe manner. Args: user_input (str): Content supplied by the user that will be inserted into the HTML response. Returns: str: The complete HTML page with user content safely escaped. """ # Escape special HTML characters to prevent script injection and # ensure the output is well-formed (CWE-707 mitigation). safe_content = html.escape(user_input, quote=True) # Format the template with the escaped content. return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
